fact: A World Bank mission of 22-26 April 2024 recorded that the government planned to onboard all 450 MDAs to the eGP starting July 2024, to be completed in about two years, and asked UDAP-GovNet to support hosting, connectivity and change management.
title: Uganda Digital Acceleration Project-GovNet (P171305): Implementation Support Mission April 22 - 26, 2024, Aide Memoire
